tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search every electric and plug-in hybrid vehicle listed for sale in the United States that Census tracks — new, used and certified, from dealers' own sites and manufacturer inventory. Returns matching listings with price, mileage, location, the seller's name and website, a seller link that forwards

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing by VIN: every field of the search record plus its asking-price history on this seller, and battery_warranty, this car's high-voltage battery warranty as its Census EV page gives it: status (for example "Expired" or "In force · 38,200 mi or 3+ yr left"), in_force, and estimated when the t

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Two to five listings by VIN, side by side: for each, its full record with its asking-price history, battery_warranty and asking_vs_similar where they exist. VINs with no live listing are returned in not_found, and any that could not be read in time in unavailable. Results are as of the `as_of` times

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Every make and model with live listings, with counts, in the exact spellings the listing search accepts.

tools.name: battery_warranty
tools.description: The manufacturer's high-voltage battery warranty for a make, model and model year, as the Census EV warranty checker gives it: the term in years and miles (with the trims each term covers where the terms differ by trim), whether it is still in force at an odometer reading where that can be establish
